outcome_analysis.explanation: Both current completed official evaluations failed, so there is no discordant official outcome. The concrete task-solving difference is that serial retained a single integrated implementation context and aligned more closely with reference module contracts, while parallel split work across children and then reconciled several locally passing but hidden-test-wrong details. Parallel therefore had a wider official failure surface, including models and optimiser failures absent in serial, but both remained non-passing because serial still failed convolution reference values and SELU init.

ordinary_implementation_differences: Parallel affine weights used input_dim by output_dim orientation, while serial used output_dim by input_dim orientation expected by hidden tests.
